_comment: Synthesized for Phase 22.7 — a 401 UNAUTHENTICATED envelope carrying a PLANTED Google API key so the image adapter's redactor has a target. Gemini's real 401 text (see auth_failed.json) does not echo the key, so this is defence in depth and NOT evidence that any provider-authored Gemini text reaches the redactor: the channel that does is `error.message` off any non-2xx body, which a proxy or gateway in front of the API can populate freely.
